units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 76b:10">Kidd. 76ᵇ</cite> <he>אנא עבידנא ס׳ דמתא</he> I want to be the officer of the town.
<cite ref="Pesachim 104b:3">Pes. 104ᵇ</cite> <he>רברבנותיה דמר וסְרָרוּתֵיה דמר</he> (Ms. O. <he>שְׂרָרוּתֵיה</he>; Ms. O. 2 <he>סַרְבָּנוּתֵיה</he>) your pride and your presumption.
